title: PUBG Mobile GameLoop FPS Drops: CPU, RAM and Settings
summary: Diagnose GameLoop stutter using measurements, controlled changes and safer Windows settings.
intro: An FPS counter can look healthy while the game still feels uneven. To troubleshoot GameLoop, distinguish constant low frame rate from short frame-time spikes and test one possible bottleneck at a time.

sections.heading: Measure the symptom before changing settings
paragraphs: Decide whether performance is always low, drops only during fights, or pauses briefly every few seconds. Repeat the same test in training or another safe environment because changing maps and player counts makes comparisons unreliable. Monitor CPU utilization by core, GPU load, memory pressure and disk activity with reputable Windows tools. A GPU at low overall use does not prove the emulator is running well; a heavily loaded CPU thread, stalled asset read or memory shortage can still delay frames. Record whether the issue began after a particular game, driver or Windows update.
points: Write down resolution and frame-rate cap before testing.
Watch frame-time stability rather than only the highest FPS displayed.

sections.heading: Check RAM and background competition
paragraphs: Close unnecessary browsers, recording programs and duplicate emulator sessions before starting a comparison. If Windows memory is almost full, the system may page data to disk and cause pauses. On a machine with a single RAM stick, dual-channel memory can help some workloads, but the benefit is not universal and should not be advertised as a guaranteed frame-rate increase. Review Windows Task Manager for real memory pressure and confirm the motherboard's supported configuration before buying upgrades. Avoid disabling essential security software to manufacture an improvement.
points: Compare memory use before and during a match.
Restart after major changes instead of stacking unknown tweaks.

sections.heading: Control graphics and resolution variables
paragraphs: Begin with a reasonable internal rendering resolution and graphics preset. Lowering render resolution may help when the GPU is saturated, but it will not fix every CPU-side stall. Check the emulator's own frame-rate and renderer options as well as the game's settings, and use supported combinations rather than forcing undocumented configuration-file edits. Large texture or effect changes can alter VRAM needs. If you test a new graphics driver, preserve the option to revert to a stable supported release. Never download a modified build promising unlocked FPS or cosmetic advantages.
points: Change only one graphics setting between comparable tests.
Record whether the improvement persists after the next emulator restart.

sections.heading: Investigate input and audio separately
paragraphs: Some players describe delayed aim or choppy mouse movement as FPS lag when the issue is input handling. Check mouse polling behavior, keymapping conflicts and whether Windows is overloaded by capture overlays. If Bluetooth audio switches modes during voice chat, latency and sound quality can change without the game engine losing frames. Test one peripheral at a time so you do not mistake an audio-routing issue for a rendering issue. Confirm that in-game keymapping still matches the current interface after updates.
points: Separate a cursor problem from a frozen image in your notes.
Disable optional overlays only temporarily for a controlled comparison.

sections.heading: Use a stable troubleshooting order
paragraphs: After each test, compare the same section of gameplay and keep the change only if it improves repeatability. If performance became worse immediately after an update, consult official GameLoop and driver release information before assuming hardware failure. Clean unnecessary temporary files through supported maintenance tools, but do not delete unknown game directories or registry keys. If a setting causes crashes, revert it. Good troubleshooting produces a short record of the original problem, one tested variable and the result—not a long list of unexplained optimization commands.
points: Reboot and retest the last known good configuration.
Treat unofficial unlock tools and tampered game files as security risks.
